skill.name: extract
skill.description: Extract clean markdown or text from known URLs using Tavily's extraction API. Use it for focused web research when you already have source URLs.
skill.summary: Extract clean web page content from specific URLs with Tavily.
skill.author: tavily-ai

security_audit.summary: The skill performs a legitimate Tavily extraction workflow through an included shell script. Confirmed risks are OAuth token cache reads, environment secret handling, bearer token transmission, and unpinned npx execution. Most Markdown backtick, example URL, and /dev/null findings are false positives, and I found no prompt injection text.

remediation.suggestion: Pin mcp-remote to a reviewed version or replace npx execution with a bundled, audited helper.
Require explicit user consent before reading ~/.mcp-auth and limit reads to Tavily-scoped token files.
Document third-party data sharing clearly and ensure tokens are never logged or sent to non-Tavily endpoints.
Label all API key values as placeholders and recommend secure secret storage for shared machines.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Package Execution During OAuth
semantic_findings.description: scripts/extract.sh runs npx -y mcp-remote when no token is found. The package version is not pinned, so authentication can execute newly published npm code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command directly invokes npx with automatic yes behavior on a package name and no version pin. This is a clear supply-chain execution risk during normal authentication.

content.user_title: Extract Clean Web Content with Tavily
content.value_statement: Clean webpage content is hard to collect when pages include navigation, scripts, and formatting noise. This skill extracts readable markdown or text from known URLs through Tavily.
actual_capabilities: Extracts page content from one or more supplied URLs through Tavily.
Returns readable markdown or plain text output.
Supports query-focused extraction with chunks per source.
Offers basic and advanced extraction depth for dynamic pages.
Can include image and favicon URLs when requested.
Uses Tavily OAuth cache or TAVILY_API_KEY for authentication.
limitations: Requires an existing Tavily account and valid authentication token.
Sends requested URLs and extraction options to Tavily.
May fail on blocked, private, or paywalled pages.
Runs an OAuth helper with npx when no token is found.

use_cases.title: Collect Research Sources
use_cases.description: Extract readable content from known articles before summarizing or comparing them.

use_cases.title: Review Documentation Pages
use_cases.description: Pull clean sections from API docs for implementation planning or support answers.

use_cases.title: Monitor Public Pages
use_cases.description: Extract content from public product pages for audits, comparisons, and update tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the extract skill to extract markdown from this URL: [URL]. Return headings, key points, and the source URL.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Several Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract content from these URLs: [URL list]. Return one section per source and note any failed pages.

prompt_templates.title: Focus By Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Targeted extraction with a research query
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract these documentation pages with query focus: [topic]. Keep only the most relevant chunks and cite each source URL.

prompt_templates.title: Use Advanced Extraction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use advanced extraction for these JavaScript-heavy pages. Include image URLs when available and summarize missing or failed content.

output_examples.input: Extract a documentation page about authentication.
output_examples.output: A readable markdown page with the title, sections, examples, and the original source URL.

output_examples.input: Extract five product pages and focus on pricing details.
output_examples.output: A source-by-source summary with relevant pricing text, extracted page content, and any failed URLs.

output_examples.input: Extract a JavaScript-heavy dashboard page with images.
output_examples.output: Advanced extraction results with visible text, available image URLs, and notes about missing content.

best_practices: Extract only URLs that you are allowed to share with Tavily.
Use query focus when you need specific sections from long pages.
Start with basic extraction, then use advanced mode for missing content.
anti_patterns: Do not send private, paid, or confidential URLs without approval.
Do not treat extracted content as verified facts without source review.
Do not batch more URLs than the API limit supports.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Tavily account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need an existing Tavily account and a valid OAuth token or API key.

faq.question: Does it search the web?
faq.answer: No. It extracts content from URLs that you already provide.

faq.question: What data is sent to Tavily?
faq.answer: The requested URLs, extraction options, and authentication token are sent to Tavily.

faq.question: Can it handle JavaScript-rendered pages?
faq.answer: Yes. Use advanced extraction for pages where basic extraction misses content.

faq.question: Where does authentication come from?
faq.answer: The script reads the MCP auth cache or uses the TAVILY_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Is it safe for private pages?
faq.answer: Use it only when your policy allows sharing those URLs and page data with Tavily.
